title: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp
claim: freeCodeCamp/freeCodeCamp — freeCodeCamp.org's open-source codebase and curriculum. Learn math, programming, and computer science for free.
why_good: The extensive curriculum and community support create a strong ecosystem that can be monetized through premium features or certifications.
value: Potential revenue streams include offering paid certifications, corporate training packages, and partnerships with educational institutions.
risk: The project might struggle to convert its large user base into paying customers, or existing educational platforms could easily replicate its model.
